pwm_channel.description: PWM channel within the controller (channel 1 under the pwm-2chan overlay).

forward_pwm_pin.description: RPWM, hardware PWM (forward -- the frequent, performance-critical direction)

reverse_pwm_pin.description: LPWM, software PWM (reverse -- parking/recovery only, tolerates the jitter)

r_en_pin.description: BCM pin for R_EN; held permanently HIGH at connect() to gate the module's overcurrent/thermal protection, not direction.

l_en_pin.description: Held permanently HIGH at connect(), like r_en_pin: it gates the module's overcurrent/thermal protection, not direction.
